data: tools/tutorials/authoring/tools/prepare_make_masks_tutorial_data.py --output <scratch>/t489/data (the Make Masks lesson's three real ER fields; the third, maskless field is shown)
alpha_features: off; CaptureSession refuses each frame otherwise. RestorationControls is not an ALPHA_FEATURES widget (591 gated only the Mask/Timelapse psf_*/enhance_* settings).

restoration.status: Restoration ready: denoise_cyto3. CPU processing; original intensities retained for measurements. On the CPU a whole field takes tens of seconds and the magnifier box about a second.

paths: source label set to the neutral /data/example root (447); console shows file names only

captions_en.01_restoration_row: Image enhancement ends with Deep image enhancement. It restores the selected channel with a Cellpose 3 model in its own environment; the image on disk is never changed.
captions_en.02_denoise_settings: Choose Denoise, Deblur or One-click restoration, then open Restoration model settings. Pick weights for cells or nuclei and set the typical object diameter in pixels.
captions_en.03_model_ready: Load the model. On the CPU a whole field takes tens of seconds; the original intensities are kept for measurements.
captions_en.04_compare: Compare raw and enhanced shows both pictures side by side. The restored picture is model output, not new structure: check it before trusting masks drawn on it.
captions_en.05_apply: Apply uses the restored picture for display and detection only. Measurements still read the original pixels.

still_owed: narration (13 voices), caption translations, web renditions and insertion into lesson 14_make_masks by the publisher/narration lane
claim: UI walkthrough only; restored pixels are model output, no accuracy or biological-improvement claim.
